audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'empowered = long stun' but never states what empowered actually does, and never mentions the shield destruction or the auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text: above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator slashes three times, destroys damage shields on the target, deals high damage and stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75. It also carries an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up — not the cast — is the moment to step out.
audit.corrected: Above 50 Fury his W stuns 1.5s and destroys damage shields; it opens with an auto reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it outright: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0. Every 'trade around his cooldown' line names no cooldown.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s, Slice and Dice 16 down to 10s from 450, Cull the Meek a flat 7s heal, Dominus 120/100/80s. Without those numbers 'wait for his cooldown' is unusable.
audit.corrected: The real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], report[9] and both Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) sits with Renekton in both layers, while the packet chart says Vayne and whys[6], spikes[3] and late all describe Vayne flipping the sidelane 1v1 there.
audit.why: The packet's defect note is about exactly this: Vayne wins 54.6% over 1445 games and the chart hands Renekton six of seven stages. Rows 0-5 genuinely are his; row 6 is not, and the prose already says so.
audit.corrected: Row 6 to Vayne in both layers as a matched pair, rating raised with it.

audit.why: Four spikes, staged correctly, and the Dominus description (bonus health, resistances, damage aura) matches Riot's text. Silver Bolts is genuinely percent-max-HP true damage, so the late-game scaling claims stand.
report[8] already calls for early Executioner's Calling, which is right: Cull the Meek heals off every unit it hits on a flat 7s cooldown, and Reign of Anger generates more Fury the lower his health.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Renekton's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 and opens with an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Slice and Dice dashes 450 and is 16s at rank 1 — punish the second half.

edits.before: That is Renekton's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury his W stuns for 1.5 seconds and destroys damage shields on you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cull the Meek heals him every 7 seconds off the whole wave.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Condemn his dash. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16s at rank 1 — above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and destroys shields. - Slice and Dice: 16s, a 450 dash. - Cull the Meek: 7s heal, so buy Executioner's Calling. - Dominus: 120s.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Condemn his dash. When it is down — W-shred + kite him.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 and above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s; Slice and Dice dashes 450 — Condemn the second half.

edits.before: Commit on Ruthless Predator's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Blade of the Ruined King timing. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit only once Ruthless Predator's 16s and Slice and Dice's 16s are both spent, and again on your Blade of the Ruined King timing.

notes: Confirmed from the mirror: Condemn knocks back and only stuns on terrain collision, so 'kite him in a straight line' in spikes[3] and late is right for damage but the stun is not guaranteed there — both strings say 'knockback', not 'stun', so they stand. Row 6 was the only chart disagreement; rows 0-5 match across full, content and packet.
